name: Secret Customers
description: Two colored curtains hide sort boxes in different columns. Each curtain has a matching Key box (scissors) of the same color — tap the right key to lift its curtain!
howToPlay: Fill the uncovered sort boxes first. Look for the two Key boxes on the grid — one pink, one blue. Each Key lifts its matching colored curtain. Tap them when the hidden boxes reach the front!
author: Claude

showcaseLevel.name: Two Curtains
showcaseLevel.desc: Match each Key to its colored curtain
